component.name: NetSonar
component.summary: Cross-platform network service monitoring, interface management, and speed tes

description.p: NetSonar is a network diagnostics and monitoring tool for probing hosts and services with ICMP, TCP, UDP, TLS, DNS, NTP, HTTP, WebSocket, SSH, SMTP, IMAP, MQTT, STUN, and SIP. Features protocol-aware latency checks, live single-service and multi-service response-time charts, network-interface inspection and configuration, and internet speed testing. Designed for administrators and developers needing lightweight, cross-platform network analysis.
